entries.scope: Enforce loopback-only HTTP and HTTPS for remote or wildcard bindings at both inventory API hosts before listener startup
entries.rationale: DE: Die Korrektur schliesst die Klartext-Transportgrenze fuer API-Schluessel und Inventardaten und aendert den dokumentierten Betriebsvertrag. EN: The fix closes the plaintext transport boundary for API keys and inventory data and changes the documented deployment contract.
readerPaths: README REST API and service deployment examples
entries.navigationImpact: No new navigation path; existing deployment and security documents describe the enforced transport boundary.
entries.languageStrategy: German first and English second in synchronized CEFR-B2 security and deployment text.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Focused tests cover IPv4 and IPv6 loopback HTTP, remote and wildcard HTTPS, remote and wildcard HTTP rejection, mixed URL lists, endpoint precedence, invalid schemes, and port-only HTTP rejection. A process-level negative startup check rejects a remote HTTP override before Kestrel binds; the full solution test run preserves local loopback clients.
entries.risk: High if an API key or inventory response can traverse a remote plaintext connection.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Kestrel endpoint configuration, proxy or certificate deployment, API hosting, URL precedence, or authentication transport changes.

entries.scope: Render the API transport TLS-gate delivery phase into the living project statistics ledger
entries.rationale: DE: Die Repository-Governance verlangt nach abgeschlossenen Features eine reproduzierbare Fortschreibung aus der kanonischen Konfiguration. EN: Repository governance requires a reproducible statistics update from the canonical configuration after completed features.
entries.navigationImpact: No navigation change; the existing statistics ledger receives one chronological entry and one generated phase slot.
entries.languageStrategy: German first and English second in the manual ledger entry; generated Profile 2 remains bilingual.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: The Bash renderer is previewed, executed, and then verified in check-only mode on macOS.
entries.risk: Low if the generated statistics are rendered from the canonical source and checked for drift.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: The API transport change volume, statistics methodology, or generated Profile 2 contract changes.
